inputs.scope: Under paragraph 10 and footnote 1 of 26EC22, what would justify concluding that the Product Provider has retained responsibility and fulfilled the requirement? Distinguish allocation of authority, supervisory conduct and operational or record-keeping outcomes. What remains unresolved without an applicable standard and actual facts? How do paragraph 14 and footnote 5 attach the request trigger, object and standard of confirmation and demonstration? What follows when no SFC request has been made, and how do paragraphs 15 and 16 differ? Preserve supported rival readings.
